events.title: DEMO V2.0X is here… and the crew just got cuddlier! 🚀
events.summary: The final version of the ASANA demo has arrived, and look who showed up to celebrate: our full set of ASANA character plushies! 🐾Softer crew. Same cosmic chaos. And yes, N.E.K.O. is still judging you.We can’t wait for you to jump into DEMO V2.0X and experience the beginning of Asana’s epic sci-fi adventure. Give it a try, meet your questionable new companions, and let us know what you think!One very important question before takeoff: which plushie is your favorite?

events.title: Demo 2.0: a rebuilt interface, and 11 languages in human hands
events.summary: Demo 2.0 arrives on 7 October, and it is the largest update the demo has had since it first went up. Two things changed: the interface was rebuilt, and the last of the localization work landed. The interface This started as a small complaint. Buttons that looked fine in English looked wrong in German. So I rebuilt the whole thing around the text instead of the other way round. Every text button now sizes itself to its label. events.title: Asana "the making"
events.summary: Hi, I'm Jacopo — a solo creator from Italy, and ASANA is my first game. Since this is the very first post on this hub, you get the origin story.Before ASANA, I made my first comic, Tokyo Roommates: two volumes, about 120 pages per volume. It went better than I dared to hope. But one note came back again and again: "too sexualized." There were no explicit scenes, and the nudity stayed artistic, but the label stuck anyway.
